question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
Such a great accomplishment can arise for a practitioner.
The yoginīs hold dear one who possesses this accomplishment.
inference: Therefore, attaining the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: Through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginīs.
